title: Molecular Interactions of Precocene Derivatives in Crystal Structures and in Silico Evaluation of Their Binding to Estrogen Receptors.
authors: Trivedi, Laxmikant; Nandini, Harsh; Gupta, Kratika; Verma, Meenakshi; Singh, Anurag; Khan, Feroz; Gupta, Atul; Vasudev, Prema G
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构分析和分子对接研究前胡素衍生物与雌激素受体的结合，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作和对接方法，但对象为小分子-受体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Crystallographic studies of potential bioactive compounds provide insight into the mode of molecular recognition and the nature of intermolecular interactions responsible for receptor-binding. Bischromans, which are dimers of precocenes, have structural similarity with 17beta-estradiol and are promising estrogen receptor (ER) agonists or antagonists. In order to understand the intermolecular interactions of biscroman-like scaffolds responsible for molecular recognition and aggregation, we analysed the crystal structures of 10 precocene derivatives in detail. The structures of derivatives 1 and 2 are reported in this study, and are compared with eight other previously reported precocene derivatives (3-10). Compounds 1-4 are precocene dimers, while 5-10 are stilbenoid derivatives of precocene. Although a hydroxyl functional group is present in 6 compounds, intermolecular hydrogen bonds are observed in the molecular packing of three derivatives, viz, 2, 5, and 8. Aromatic ring interactions are found in 9 out of 10 crystal structures, marking them as a major contributor in facilitating molecular aggregation. Molecular docking analysis indicates that compounds 1-10 have moderate to high binding affinity with ERalpha and ERbeta. Notably, all derivatives that bind at the ligand-binding pocket showed favorable centroid...centroid distances with Phe404 (ERalpha) and Phe356 (ERbeta), mimicking the binding of 17beta-estradiol to the ER proteins.
abstract_zh: 潜在生物活性化合物的晶体学研究为分子识别模式及负责受体结合的分子间相互作用性质提供了见解。双色满（Bischromans）作为早熟素（precocenes）的二聚体，与17β-雌二醇具有结构相似性，并有望成为雌激素受体（ER）激动剂或拮抗剂。为了理解负责分子识别和聚集的双色满类骨架的分子间相互作用，我们详细分析了10种早熟素衍生物的晶体结构。本研究报道了衍生物1和2的结构，并与先前报道的其他8种早熟素衍生物（3-10）进行了比较。化合物1-4为早熟素二聚体，而5-10为早熟素的二苯乙烯类衍生物。尽管6种化合物中存在羟基官能团，但在三种衍生物（即2、5和8）的分子堆积中观察到分子间氢键。在10种晶体结构中有9种发现了芳香环相互作用，这标志着它们是促进分子聚集的主要贡献者。分子对接分析表明，化合物1-10与ERα和ERβ具有中等至高的结合亲和力。值得注意的是，所有结合在配体结合口袋中的衍生物均显示出与Phe404（ERα）和Phe356（ERβ）有利的质心...质心距离，模拟了17β-雌二醇与ER蛋白的结合方式。
